name: Wayfarer's Ring (Hành Lữ Giới)
lore: A copper ring worn smooth by travelling cultivators who never stayed long enough to join a sect.
build_use: Any build: a little fortune and faster cultivation for the long road before the build comes together.

name: Pilgrim's Flying Sword (Hành Hương Phi Kiếm)

arts.name: Wayfarer's Cut (Hành Lữ Trảm)
arts.rule: A plain quick Physical cut that carries no element, so it never fights a build's own.

lore: The cheap blade sold at every sect gate to disciples sent on their first pilgrimage.
build_use: Any build's first weapon: an element-less quick cut that holds a slot until the build's own arts arrive.

name: Stitchwind Needles (Phùng Phong Châm)

arts.name: Threading Rain (Xuyên Châm Vũ)
arts.rule: A cheap, quick Physical volley. With half your health gone it threads a second pass, 1.6 times as hard.

lore: A tailor's needles tempered until they sing; the tailor sewed up wounds and then opened a few.
build_use: Quick-art and crit builds: Echo makes each needle volley strike twice, and the desperate throw pays when the fight turns.

name: Bulwark of the Road (Lộ Trình Thuẫn)

wards.name: Bulwark Light (Lộ Thuẫn Quang)
wards.notes: The starter shield at 1.25 times its shield and its cast cost, so the price check is unchanged (3.750 of 3.813)

lore: A caravan guard's shield dented by a hundred bandit blades and never once pierced.
build_use: Art-speed and talisman builds that lean on a cast shield: the Golden Light Shield, stronger and cheaper to keep up.

name: Seeker's Pendant (Tầm Đạo Bội)

reserve_arts.name: Seeker's Aura (Tầm Đạo Quang)
reserve_arts.rule: While reserved, you resist statuses better and your escape is likelier.
reserve_arts.notes: Priced by Formulas I reserve arts: 10 % reserved buys up to 10 W (uses 7 W)

lore: Jade from the road to a hidden sect; it grows warm when the right turning is near.
build_use: Fortune and escape builds: steady fortune, a surer getaway, and an aura that helps against curses.

name: Hundred-Patch Armour (Bách Nạp Giáp)

wards.name: Hundred-Patch Ward (Bách Nạp Hộ Thể)
wards.notes: The starter ward at 1.2 times its payload and its drain, so the price check is unchanged (3.049 of 3.050)

lore: Every hole in it was mended with a scrap from a different sect's robe; no single art knows how to read it.
build_use: Any build that wants to outlast: the Common Ward made stronger, and Final Clause fires the longest art free as the wearer goes Down.

name: Five-Phase Flag (Ngũ Hành Kỳ)

effects.name: Wheel in the Flag (Ngũ Hành Tụ Kỳ)
effects.rule: Your arts deal 5 % more for each element whose buff stacks you hold, up to five elements.
effects.reads: Elements with at least one of your buff stacks, live
effects.from: five-elements.md, Five-Phase Flag (Ngũ Hành Kỳ), as an Effect
effects.status: accepted for now (user, 2026-11-12); not yet in effects.md

lore: A banner with five pennants, one per phase; refined with one material of each element, it is never quite finished.
build_use: The Wheel of Generation, The Overcomer, The Primordial Sage: a flag with five element slots, each element held lifting every art.

name: Talisman-Bearer's Ring (Phù Sứ Giới)
lore: A silver ring engraved with a talisman-writers' guild seal; the guild pays its debts in paper, and so does the wearer.
build_use: Talisman builds: Paid in Advance, so every talisman fires free of linh lực, faster and harder.
notes: Spends 81 %: Paid in Advance is a strong enabler

name: Heaven-Purchasing Coin (Mãi Thiên Tiền)

effects.name: Bought Fate (Mãi Mệnh)
effects.rule: Once a fight, a roll that goes against you (a crit you take, an evade that fails, an escape that fails) goes your way instead.
effects.payload: One roll flipped in your favour
effects.closes: Each flip burns spirit stones worth 5 % of the spirit stones you carry; with none carried it does nothing.
effects.from: user decision 2026-11-12 (the general coin, no longer a second Seal of Full Payment)
effects.status: accepted for now (user, 2026-11-12); not yet in effects.md

arts.name: Last Coin Flick (Tuyệt Tiền Kích)
arts.rule: A flicked coin: a quick Physical hit. With 40 % of your health gone it is the last coin in the purse, and flies four times as hard.

holder: A Nascent Soul merchant-cultivator who deals in spirit stones; otherwise Lost in a buried merchant vault
lore: The first spirit stone ever cut, they say, and the one that bought a sect its mountain.
build_use: Any build that dies to one bad roll: once a fight a crit taken, a failed evade or a failed escape flips your way, paid in carried spirit stones.

name: Mirror of the Second Seat (Nhị Tòa Kính)
holder: The elder of a sect's treasure hall at Core Formation or above; otherwise Lost in a collapsed sect vault
lore: It shows its holder seated twice, once in the hall and once in the heaven above, and lets both hold a treasure.
build_use: Every build: one extra artifact slot, plus Cold Feet for the first escape; the classic piece a build hunts for.

name: Long-Road Robe (Trường Lộ Bào)

wards.name: Long-Road Ward (Trường Lộ Hộ Thể)
wards.notes: The starter ward at 1.15 times its payload and its drain, so the price check is unchanged

lore: A grey travelling robe whose hem has seen every road in the realm; it asks little of the mind that wears it.
build_use: Builds that must spend every last point of thần thức or lift the extra-slot limit: a standing ward the engine can run, on a robe that costs only 6 TT and no art speed.
notes: Answers: bare-fist: a utility treasure adding than_thuc_pct; cooldown-floor: a cheap extra (TT 6 or less); curse-engine: a ward armour that costs no art speed.

name: Lantern of Waking (Tỉnh Mộng Đăng)

reserve_arts.name: Waking Light (Tỉnh Mộng Quang)
reserve_arts.rule: While reserved, curses and statuses cling to you less and your escape is likelier.
reserve_arts.notes: Priced by Formulas I reserve arts: 12 % reserved buys up to 12 W (uses 11.75 W)

lore: A paper lantern that gutters when a curse draws near and shakes sleepers awake before the knife falls.
build_use: Soul and curse-pressed builds: a resistance aura and a first escape at once, standing in for the lost Bell of Waking and Lantern Out.
notes: Answers: soul-lance: a cleanse or escape treasure.
